title: Feeling Rooted
snippet:
Living miles away,
a place lingers within.

Just the very thought of it
fills my heart with a quiet peace.
content:
Living miles away,
a place lingers within.

Just the very thought of it
fills my heart with a quiet peace.

The freshness in the air.
The fragrance of the wet soil.
The endless stretch of green fields.
The gentle chime of the temple bells.
The wide-spreading branches
of that old mango tree.
I feel rooted there.

The cheerful chirping of birds.
The squirrels darting from branch to branch.
The moos from the cowshed.
The rhythmic creak of the pulley
drawing water from the well.
The sound of that blowpipe
firing the wood.
I feel rooted there.

The two storey tiled ancestral house
The wall lined with old photographs
The piled up newspapers
The rays of light through the windows
Fills the little rooms
The diya lighting the idol in the shelf
The long verandas and the polished floor.
I feel rooted there.

My soul finds its way back
The breeze whispers...
“You belong here.”
